reason: I earn about $1,200 a month and run everything from Telegram and a notebook, so $29 for a tool I have never used is a real bite. Bitrix24 has a free plan, so I would try that first.
objection: Why pay $29 a month when Bitrix24 is free, and when these guys are new with no references and only a few paying companies?
would_change_my_mind: A free plan or a free trial for a month or two where I can see my Telegram clients come in, plus one company I know saying it works for them.
